caption: 8:47 AM on a packed Virar fast local, and then gravity switches off for 5 seconds. Everyone and everything inside starts to drift: bags, dabbas, shoes, newspapers. Your cutting chai wouldn't spill the normal way either. In weightlessness, surface tension pulls liquid into floating blobs and spheres, just like astronauts see on the International Space Station. The train wouldn't stop. Without weight pressing the wheels onto the rails there's almost no grip, so it would simply keep coasting forward. Then, 5 seconds later, gravity comes back and everything drops at once. Chaos for everyone... except maybe the one who lands in a window seat. Where would YOU want to be when it happens? 👇
